items.title: Jon Weber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 2, 2012
items.q: Thelonious Monk I’m certain was not thought to be the next Art Tatum in his day.

ctx.x: Yeah. He is, that’s his situation. He loves to play. It’s sort of ironic now that to pursue that likely you have to give up everything. First, most people have to go pay fifty grand to go to Berklee every year. You know, the investment, to put into it to get to that place where you’re not going to be rich is a dichotomy of some —

Although there is that one lucky person who breaks through and you never know who it’s going to be. Sometimes the nerdy kid with the horned-rimmed glasses ends up — I’m not saying that’s your student — but I’m saying the least likely to succeed — I don’t even remember this kid in high school — ten thousand bucks a gig? Jeez, what happened? It could happen you know. You never know what the next big thing is going to be and you never know if they come up — who knows? Thelonious Monk I’m certain was not thought to…
Is there such a thing as a wrong note?
